query:
SELECT a.id, a.patientId, p.name as paciente, a.therapistUserId, u.name as terapeuta, a.startTime, a.endTime, a.status 
FROM appointments a
JOIN patients p ON a.patientId = p.id
JOIN users u ON a.therapistUserId = u.id
WHERE a.id IN (1140008, 1140009);
